prompt.project_info: Create a clean studio portrait of an approved adult woman making a small heart gesture near her chin.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long wavy brown hair, straight bangs, vivid blue eyes, soft brown shadow, peach blush, pink glossy lips, and pastel hair clips. She wears a pink strappy camisole with black lace trim, blue plaid skirt, and delicate necklace. Her full-body pose uses a gentle natural S-curve, hands forming a small heart near the chin, direct gaze, and soft micro-smile.
prompt.composition_elements: Full figure with shoes and headroom, clean pastel sage seamless background, front-facing studio framing, hands and heart gesture near face, balanced pastel pink/sage palette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Large diffused softbox front-left, white bounce fill, gentle rim on hair, even high-key skin illumination, cute playful tasteful mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame 70mm lens, f/2.2, ISO 200, 1/160s equivalent, eye-detect focus, natural pores and flyaway hair, subtle grain, 3:4 portrait.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a clean photorealistic studio portrait of an approved adult woman with long wavy brown hair, straight bangs, vivid blue eyes, pastel hair clips, soft brown eyeshadow, peach blush, and pink glossy lips. She wears a pink strappy camisole with black lace trim, a blue plaid skirt, and delicate necklace. Compose a full-figure front-facing portrait with shoes and headroom against a soft pastel sage seamless background. She makes a small heart gesture with both hands near her chin, maintains a direct gaze, gentle micro-smile, and natural relaxed pose. Use a 70mm f/2.2 full-frame perspective, large diffused softbox, white bounce fill, soft hair rim, even high-key light, realistic pores, flyaway hair, accurate fingers, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic doll skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, broken heart gesture, text, logo
